title: Run [A4]'s real cloud and local epic runs on the integrated pi-durable epic
description:
Epic 43y's [A4] (and [A2]'s 'in a real run') needs one real hn6-style cloud epic run and one local epic run on pi-durable. Neither can run inside jhp. The factory deploys only from main, so a cloud run executes main's code, not the epic's. A local run needs 2q5 (local implement on the durable host, merged on epic/43y but not on jhp's base) and nou (local durable worker no-commits, in flight). jhp delivered the staging [A2] proof (10/10 claims, harness/proof/README.md) and the deletion. The runs belong to a tick placed after nou and qf4 integrate, with the cloud half after the factory carries the epic's code.
evidence: cloudflare deploy-factory deploys main only (AGENTS.md); .tick/issues/nou.json; epic/43y has 2q5's profiles-herdr re-cut that jhp's base lacks
